text: Steve Teekens, Executive Director, Native Men's Residence, and Mary-Anne Bedard, General Manager, Shelter, Support and Housing Administration (SSHA), City of Toronto, will give a presentation on Meeting in the Middle - Update on Implementation. The presentation will outline the actions SSHA has undertaken to implement Meeting in the Middle, an engagement strategy and action plan co-developed by SSHA, the Indigenous Community Advisory Board, and the Toronto Aboriginal Support Services Council to foster better relationships in order to more meaningfully address Indigenous homelessness in Toronto.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
